name: v3.17.0
body:
## What's Changed
* npm bin no longer exists by @jpmens in https://github.com/astefanutti/decktape/pull/414
* correct small typo by @jpmens in https://github.com/astefanutti/decktape/pull/413
* Use a local cross-origin iframe fixture for visual tests by @astefanutti in https://github.com/astefanutti/decktape/pull/416
* Fix remark PDF clipping caused by CSS page sizing by @astefanutti in https://github.com/astefanutti/decktape/pull/415
* Use Puppeteer-managed Chrome in a slim Debian image by @astefanutti in https://github.com/astefanutti/decktape/pull/417
* Limit Node Docker updates to minor and patch releases by @astefanutti in https://github.com/astefanutti/decktape/pull/421
* Support exporting into volumes mounted with an arbitrary UID by @astefanutti in https://github.com/astefanutti/decktape/pull/422
* Clarify Podman UID mapping and test an unregistered UID by @astefanutti in https://github.com/astefanutti/decktape/pull/423
* Fail fast when the output directory is not writable by @astefanutti in https://github.com/astefanutti/decktape/pull/424
* Wait for the web fonts and the video frames before printing by @astefanutti in https://github.com/astefanutti/decktape/pull/425
* Extract filesystem helpers into libs/files.js by @astefanutti in https://github.com/astefanutti/decktape/pull/426
* Document the SELinux relabelling of the mounted volumes by @astefanutti in https://github.com/astefanutti/decktape/pull/427
* chore(deps): bump @xmldom/xmldom from 0.8.12 to 0.8.13 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/astefanutti/decktape/pull/406

## New Contributors
* @jpmens made their first contribution in https://github.com/astefanutti/decktape/pull/414

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/astefanutti/decktape/compare/v3.16.1...v3.17.0
